docs.summary: Smooths over a pose discontinuity: the gap between the old and new pose, and its velocity, decay to zero over the blend time. Feed it every frame through [`Apply`](#api~Prowl.Motion.Inertializer~Apply).
True while an offset is still decaying.
Drops the history and any running blend.

docs.summary: True if a bone steps further than the threshold and several times further than the frame before, which reads as a discontinuity rather than motion.

members.name: Begin
members.signature: public void Begin(Pose target, float blendSeconds)

docs.summary: Starts a blend: the gap between the last output and `target` decays to zero over `blendSeconds`. Needs two frames of history.

members.name: Apply
members.signature: public void Apply(Pose target, Pose result, float deltaTime)

docs.summary: Writes `target` into `result` with any running offset added, and records the frame as history. The two poses may be the same object.
